Ui.Script:
-- ── GlobalStrings values this window uses (ref-GlobalStrings.lua, cited per line — the -- `X = X or "..."` idiom matches CastingBar.xml/CharacterFrame.xml's own convention) ──── SPELLBOOK = SPELLBOOK or "Spellbook" -- :3820 PAGE_NUMBER = PAGE_NUMBER or "Page %d" -- :2981
-- ── This window's own constants (ref SpellBookFrame.lua:1-7, Benilla-prefixed where the -- ref's own name would collide with the engine's BOOKTYPE_SPELL/BOOKTYPE_PET globals — -- this file's header comment on that one deviation) ───────────────────────────────────── SPELLS_PER_PAGE = 12 MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS = 8 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS = {}
-- ── The window: toggle (ref ToggleSpellBook, l.9-50) ───────────────────────────────────── -- Kept BARE (not Benilla-prefixed) — the addon-facing entry point, matching this -- codebase's own ToggleCharacter/ToggleQuestLog precedent. The ref's `HasPetSpells()` -- short-circuit (blocking a toggle INTO an empty pet book) is dropped outright — this -- file's header comment, the pet book is never fed so `bookType` is always -- BOOKTYPE_SPELL in practice. The ref's own DUPLICATED prev/next enable/disable (once -- inside the `currentPage > maxPages` clamp branch, once again unconditionally right -- after — both produce the identical end state) collapses to the ONE -- BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() call already shared by every other page-turn site -- below — a redundant-code cleanup, not a behavior change. function ToggleSpellBook(bookType) local isVisible = BenillaSpellBookFrame:IsVisible() HideUIPanel(BenillaSpellBookFrame) if (not isVisible or (BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType ~= bookType)) then BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType = bookType ShowUIPanel(BenillaSpellBookFrame) end BenillaSpellBook_ClampPage() BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() BenillaSpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage())) end
-- Clamp the selected tab's page back onto range (ref's own inline logic inside -- ToggleSpellBook, l.22-26) — split out so both ToggleSpellBook and a future re-entry -- share it, rather than inlining it twice. function BenillaSpellBook_ClampPage() local currentPage, maxPages = BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage() if currentPage > maxPages then SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = maxPages BenillaUpdateSpells() end end
function BenillaSpellBookFrame_OnLoad(frame) frame:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") -- LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB OMITTED — this file's header comment. frame.bookType = BOOKTYPE_SPELL for i = 1, MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS do SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[i] = 1 end BenillaSpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(1) end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnEvent (l.75-92), the SPELLS_CHANGED branch only (LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB -- OMITTED, header comment). function BenillaSpellBookFrame_OnEvent(frame) if event == "SPELLS_CHANGED" and frame:IsVisible() then BenillaSpellBookFrame_Update() BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() end end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnShow (l.94-105): MultiActionBar_ShowAllGrids OMITTED (header -- comment); the tab-flash UIFrameFlash call goes with LEARNED_SPELL_IN_TAB. -- UpdateMicroButtons is LIVE as of the micro-menu slice (MicroMenu.xml). function BenillaSpellBookFrame_OnShow() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end BenillaSpellBookFrame_Update(1) end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_Update (l.107-164): the Spell/Pet toggle-tab hide loop and the -- HasPetSpells()/petTitle branch are DROPPED outright (header comment — no pet book, no -- toggle row exists at all this slice). function BenillaSpellBookFrame_Update(showing) if showing then BenillaSpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) BenillaUpdateSpells() end local numSkillLineTabs = GetNumSpellTabs() for i = 1, MAX_SKILLLINE_TABS do local skillLineTab = getglobal("BenillaSpellBookSkillLineTab" .. i) if i <= numSkillLineTabs then local name, texture = GetSpellTabInfo(i) skillLineTab:SetNormalTexture(texture) skillLineTab.tooltip = name skillLineTab:Show() skillLineTab:SetChecked(BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine == i) else skillLineTab:Hide() end end BenillaSpellBookTitleText:SetText(SPELLBOOK) if showing then PlaySound("igSpellBookOpen") end end
-- ref SpellBookFrame_OnHide (l.186-204): MultiActionBar_HideAllGrids and the tab-flash -- cleanup OMITTED (header comment); always the spell-book close kit (no pet book to branch -- on). UpdateMicroButtons is LIVE as of the micro-menu slice (MicroMenu.xml). function BenillaSpellBookFrame_OnHide() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igSpellBookClose") end
-- UpdateSpells(): the ref's OWN global (`SpellBookFrame.lua:26/116/411/426/450` — never -- DEFINED in this session's extraction, a base-UI/C-level helper outside this file) -- transcribed here as BenillaUpdateSpells(): refresh every spell button on the current -- page (this file's own convention: explicit button params, not ambient `this`). function BenillaUpdateSpells() for i = 1, SPELLS_PER_PAGE do BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(getglobal("BenillaSpellButton" .. i)) end end
-- ── The spell button (ref SpellButton_*, l.206-404) ────────────────────────────────────── -- CRAFT_SHOW/_CLOSE/TRADE_SKILL_SHOW/_CLOSE/PET_BAR_UPDATE are OMITTED (header comment: -- no craft/trade-skill window arm, no pet bar); SPELLS_CHANGED and SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN -- drive the full refresh (the ref's own shared branch, l.221) and -- CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED the checked ring (ref SpellButton_OnEvent's own split). function BenillaSpellButton_OnLoad(button) button:RegisterEvent("SPELLS_CHANGED") button:RegisterEvent("CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED") button:RegisterEvent("SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN") button:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") button:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) end
function BenillaSpellButton_OnEvent(button) if event == "SPELLS_CHANGED" or event == "SPELL_UPDATE_COOLDOWN" then BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) elseif event == "CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED" then BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) end end
-- ref SpellButton_UpdateSelection (l.292-306): the checked ring — `IsCurrentCast` over -- the app-resolved verdict (the ACTIVE shapeshift form's own spell — Ghost Wolf glows -- while the shaman is the wolf, a druid form likewise; the engine predicate `0x4b3600` -- deliberately has NO casting-now arm, so an ordinary cast never lights a book slot). -- The ref's out-of-tab bounds fork collapses into the one SetChecked: IsCurrentCast -- answers nil past the book's end already. function BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) local id = BenillaSpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) button:SetChecked(IsCurrentCast(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType)) end
-- ref SpellButton_OnEnter (l.235-244): the engine's SetSpell — the byte-verified spell -- line law (decision 0276: cost|range one line, casttime|cooldown one line, passives -- omit it, the $-substituted gold description; no rank column from the book — the -- verified showRank=0). function BenillaSpellButton_OnEnter(button) if not GameTooltip then return end -- engine tests load file subsets local id = BenillaSpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) if not GetSpellName(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetSpell(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) end
-- ref SpellButton_OnClick (l.263-290): the MacroFrame branch and the right-click pet -- autocast fork are both OMITTED (header comment) — shift-click always picks up (the -- ref's own "no MacroFrame visible" fallthrough), every other click casts. The -- `id > MAX_SPELLS` guard is dropped too: GetSpellName/CastSpell/PickupSpell already -- answer nil/no-op for any id past the book's real length, so the extra guard checks -- nothing a MAX_SPELLS constant would add here. function BenillaSpellButton_OnClick(button, drag) local id = BenillaSpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) button:SetChecked("false") if drag then PickupSpell(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) elseif IsShiftKeyDown() then -- ref SpellButton_OnClick l.271-283 (LIVE since decision 0983): with the macro -- editor open a shift-click APPENDS `/cast <name>[(<rank>)]` to the body instead of -- picking the spell up — the behaviour MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE5 advertises ("shift -- click a spell in your spellbook with the macro UI open to add it to your macro"). -- The `/cast` alias comes from the shipped strings (SLASH_CAST1), never typed here. local macroFrame = getglobal("BenillaMacroFrame") if macroFrame and macroFrame:IsVisible() then local spellName, subSpellName = GetSpellName(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) if spellName and not IsSpellPassive(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) then local line = (SLASH_CAST1 or "/cast") .. " " .. spellName if subSpellName and string.len(subSpellName) > 0 then line = line .. "(" .. subSpellName .. ")" end BenillaMacroFrame_AddMacroLine(line) end else PickupSpell(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) end else CastSpell(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) -- ref l.288: the ring re-reads at once end end
-- ref SpellButton_UpdateButton (l.307-404): the autocast overlay/model is OMITTED -- (header comment); the cooldown sweep (l.359-365) and the checked-ring tail call are -- LIVE. Passive gates CastSpell engine-side (spellbook.rs), not here — this only grays -- the presentation. function BenillaSpellButton_UpdateButton(button) if not button:IsVisible() then return end if GameTooltip:IsOwned(button) then BenillaSpellButton_OnEnter(button) end if not BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine then BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine = 1 end local temp, tabTexture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) offset = offset or 0 numSpells = numSpells or 0 BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset = offset local id = BenillaSpellBook_GetSpellID(button:GetID()) local name = button:GetName() local iconTexture = getglobal(name .. "IconTexture") local spellString = getglobal(name .. "SpellName") local subSpellString = getglobal(name .. "SubSpellName") local cooldown = getglobal(name .. "Cooldown") if id > (offset + numSpells) then button:Disable() iconTexture:Hide() spellString:Hide() subSpellString:Hide() cooldown:Hide() button:SetChecked(0) getglobal(name .. "NormalTexture"):SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) return else button:Enable() end local texture = GetSpellTexture(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) local highlightTexture = getglobal(name .. "Highlight") local normalTexture = getglobal(name .. "NormalTexture") if (not texture) or (texture == "") then iconTexture:Hide() spellString:Hide() subSpellString:Hide() cooldown:Hide() highlightTexture:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square") button:SetChecked(0) normalTexture:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) return end -- The cooldown sweep + the enable-keyed icon dim (ref l.359-365): enable == 0 is an -- on-hold cooldown (Stealth/Feign Death parked until SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT) — the -- widget stays hidden (CooldownFrame_SetTimer's own gate) and the icon reads 40%. local start, duration, enable = GetSpellCooldown(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) CooldownFrame_SetTimer(cooldown, start, duration, enable) if enable == 1 then iconTexture:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) else iconTexture:SetVertexColor(0.4, 0.4, 0.4) end local spellName, subSpellName = GetSpellName(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) local isPassive = IsSpellPassive(id, BenillaSpellBookFrame.bookType) if isPassive then normalTexture:SetVertexColor(0, 0, 0) highlightTexture:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-PassiveHighlight") spellString:SetTextColor(PASSIVE_SPELL_FONT_COLOR.r, PASSIVE_SPELL_FONT_COLOR.g, PASSIVE_SPELL_FONT_COLOR.b) else normalTexture:SetVertexColor(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) highlightTexture:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\ButtonHilight-Square") spellString:SetTextColor(NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b) end iconTexture:SetTexture(texture) spellString:SetText(spellName) subSpellString:SetText(subSpellName) if subSpellName and subSpellName ~= "" then spellString:SetPoint("LEFT", button, "RIGHT", 4, 4) else spellString:SetPoint("LEFT", button, "RIGHT", 4, 2) end iconTexture:Show() spellString:Show() subSpellString:Show() BenillaSpellButton_UpdateSelection(button) -- ref l.403: every full refresh re-reads the ring end
-- ── Page turn (ref PrevPageButton_OnClick/NextPageButton_OnClick, l.406-434) ───────────── -- Always the spell-book page-turn kit (no pet book to branch on, header comment). function BenillaSpellBookPrevPageButton_OnClick() local pageNum = BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage() - 1 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = pageNum BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() BenillaSpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, pageNum)) BenillaUpdateSpells() PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") end
function BenillaSpellBookNextPageButton_OnClick() local pageNum = BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage() + 1 SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] = pageNum BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() BenillaSpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, pageNum)) BenillaUpdateSpells() PlaySound("igAbiliityPageTurn") end
-- ── The skill-line tabs (ref SpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick, l.436-457) ─────────────────── function BenillaSpellBookSkillLineTab_OnClick(id) local update if not id then update = 1 id = this:GetID() end BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine = id local name, texture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(id) BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset = offset or 0 BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineNumSpells = numSpells or 0 BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() BenillaSpellBookFrame_Update() BenillaSpellBookPageText:SetText(format(PAGE_NUMBER, BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage())) if update then BenillaUpdateSpells() end end
-- ref SpellBook_GetSpellID (l.459-465): the pet-book `return id` branch is DROPPED -- outright (header comment — bookType is always BOOKTYPE_SPELL, dead code for this -- window). This is the book-id the engine's own byte-verified seam expects verbatim -- (`benilla-ui/src/script/spellbook.rs`'s own module doc). function BenillaSpellBook_GetSpellID(id) return id + (BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLineOffset or 0) + (SPELLS_PER_PAGE * ((SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] or 1) - 1)) end
-- ref SpellBook_UpdatePageArrows (l.467-479). function BenillaSpellBook_UpdatePageArrows() local currentPage, maxPages = BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage() if currentPage == 1 then BenillaSpellBookPrevPageButton:Disable() else BenillaSpellBookPrevPageButton:Enable() end if currentPage == maxPages then BenillaSpellBookNextPageButton:Disable() else BenillaSpellBookNextPageButton:Enable() end end
-- ref SpellBook_GetCurrentPage (l.481-493): the pet-book branch is DROPPED outright -- (header comment). `maxPages` is clamped to at least 1 (a defensive addition this file's -- own — an empty/not-yet-fed book must still show ONE (empty) page rather than disabling -- both page buttons into a currentPage=1 > maxPages=0 dead state). function BenillaSpellBook_GetCurrentPage() local currentPage = SPELLBOOK_PAGENUMBERS[BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine] or 1 local temp, texture, offset, numSpells = GetSpellTabInfo(BenillaSpellBookFrame.selectedSkillLine) local maxPages = max(ceil((numSpells or 0) / SPELLS_PER_PAGE), 1) return currentPage, maxPages end

Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if self.tooltip then GameTooltip:SetText(self.tooltip) GameTooltip:Show() end
